description:
Intent: independent Enum calls must not contaminate one another's list element ABI. Current minimal pairs are individually discriminating: Enum.scan over [integer] followed by Enum.with_index over [string], Enum.intersperse over [integer] followed by Enum.with_index over [string], and Enum.map_every over [integer] followed by Enum.map_join over [string]. Each operation passes alone and every pair is oracle-correct in interp; native run and AOT execute the first call, then abort in fz_list_head_int_ref when the second string-list helper is entered through a RawInt element ABI.

This is not a runtime tag-check problem. Trace activation/executable identity and its input/return transport facts to the first point where two semantically distinct list surfaces share or select one physical representative. Preserve/refine the distinct authoritative surfaces or collapse only if they are observably equivalent; do not select by Ty id, order, or downstream payload inspection.

Acceptance: all three minimal pairs pass interp/run/build, each helper still passes alone, and full enum_map_family matches its oracle on all paths without a runtime defensive coercion; a focused production-path test proves the two helper activations retain the correct list element ABIs; lib and clippy pass.
title: Keep independent Enum list-helper activations from sharing the wrong element ABI
